configurePresets.name: _xcode
configurePresets.description: Common base: emit an Xcode project from vm64/CMakeLists.txt.

configurePresets.name: _visionos
configurePresets.description: Common base for the headless visionOS VM (libSelfVM.a, no Quartz/X11). SELF_AS_LIBRARY defaults ON for visionOS in CMakeLists; the OSX_SYSROOT (xros vs xrsimulator) is set by each leaf preset.

configurePresets.name: macos
configurePresets.description: Editable macOS Self.app dev project. Defaults give Quartz+X11 and SELF_AS_LIBRARY=OFF. Build Debug or Release by picking the configuration in the scheme.

configurePresets.name: macos-lib
configurePresets.description: macOS arm64 libSelfVM.a, headless (no Quartz/X11), SELF_AS_LIBRARY=ON -- the macOS analogue of the visionOS lib. For linking the VM straight into a host app inside Enchilada.xcworkspace (host-bridge workspace unification / E.2+), instead of the prebuilt xcframework. -- claude & dmu 5/26

configurePresets.name: visionos
configurePresets.displayName: visionOS VM project (editable; linked by SpatialSelf)
configurePresets.description: The visionOS VM Xcode project. SpatialSelf links THIS generated project as a cross-project dependency (its libSelfVM.a / Self target), so run `configure.sh visionos` to (re)create cmake-build-AVP-compilation-check/Self.xcodeproj before building SpatialSelf -- it is generated, not checked in. SDKROOT=xros but Xcode builds the xrsimulator slice too on demand (sysroot is not baked into the flags). Also fine for fast Debug compile-checks. (binaryDir name is historical -- 'compile-check' predates the SpatialSelf coupling.) -- claude & dmu 5/26

configurePresets.name: xcframework-device
configurePresets.description: xros device slice that configure.sh xcframework builds (RelWithDebInfo) and bundles.

configurePresets.name: xcframework-sim
configurePresets.description: xrsimulator slice that configure.sh xcframework builds (RelWithDebInfo) and bundles.
